stem.zh-CN: 在[[term:neural-network|深度神经网络（Deep Neural Networks）]]的典型结构中，**[[term:hidden-layer|隐藏层（Hidden Layer）]]**的主要作用是：
stem.en-US: In the typical structure of a [[term:neural-network|deep neural network]], what is the main role of a **[[term:hidden-layer|hidden layer]]**?

explanation.zh-CN: [[term:hidden-layer|隐藏层]]利用权重、偏置和[[term:activation-function|激活函数]]逐层提取数据中的复杂特征。
explanation.en-US: A [[term:hidden-layer|hidden layer]] uses weights, biases, and [[term:activation-function|activation functions]] to extract complex features from data layer by layer.

primaryConcept.zh-CN: 隐藏层的非线性特征表示学习
primaryConcept.en-US: Nonlinear feature representation learning in hidden layers

text.zh-CN: 负责显示模型的最终预测结果（如分类标签或回归数值）。
text.en-US: It displays the model's final prediction, such as a class label or regression value.

text.zh-CN: 接收外部输入的原始数据，并将其直接传递给[[term:output-layer|输出层]]。
text.en-US: It receives raw external input and passes it directly to the [[term:output-layer|output layer]].

text.zh-CN: 通过多层次的非线性变换，从原始特征中自动提取和构造更高阶的特征表示。
text.en-US: It automatically extracts and constructs higher-level feature representations through multiple nonlinear transformations.

text.zh-CN: 存储训练过程中的[[term:loss-function|损失函数]]值，以便计算[[term:gradient|梯度]]的方向。
text.en-US: It stores [[term:loss-function|loss]] values from training so that the direction of the [[term:gradient|gradient]] can be computed.
